India's real GDP growth over the last 5 full financial years ran from a Covid dip of -5.8% in FY 2020-21 to a rebound of 9.7% the next year, then settled at 6.5% in FY 2024-25. These are rounded figures from memory of the government's revised numbers and they get revised, so check the latest from MoSPI before quoting them anywhere.
